title: New feature request - Add GVI and PGS calculations in Statistics and History
symptom: The issue requests adding GVI and PGS calculations to xDrip+ Statistics and History, similar to Nightscout. Later, a user reports discrepancies in results between Nightscout and xDrip+ due to filtering of low BG values.
cause: The discrepancy was caused by xDrip excluding BG values below a sensor threshold (e.g., <39) from calculations, while Nightscout did not exclude them. Additionally, the PGS calculation in xDrip uses user-defined upper and lower limits, which can lead to inconsistent results compared to the intended fixed range.
fix: AdrianLxM added the same two filter passes to xDrip as used in Nightscout, which resolved the discrepancies. For PGS, it was suggested to use a fixed range of 70-180 mg/dL instead of user-defined limits, but this was not implemented in the thread.
evidence_quote: I've added the same two filter passes to xDrip like you did to Nightscout now.
